description: Pizza cards with a size and a crust radio group and an add button.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Pizzas with a picker on each card: the picture, name and toppings, a radio group of sizes and one of crusts
  (each a fieldset with role radiogroup), the price and an add button. Axes: layout (cards, rows), tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Dish, FoodLabels } from "./dish-showcase.types";
  import type { DishOption } from "../components/option-chips.types";

  export type PizzaPickerProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    dishes: Dish[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: FoodLabels;
    sizes: DishOption[];
    crusts: DishOption[];
    layout?: "cards" | "rows";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Inline from "../compose/Inline.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import OptionChips from "../components/option-chips.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    dishes,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    sizes,
    crusts,
    layout = "cards",
    tone = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: PizzaPickerProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} tone={tone} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((dishes?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="star" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    <Box
      class={
        (layout as string) === "rows" ? "flex flex-col gap-4"
        : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 md:grid-cols-3"
      }
      data-testid="items"
    >
      {#each dishes as d (d.id)}
        <Box
          class={
            (layout as string) === "rows" ? "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 p-4 md:grid-cols-3"
            : "rounded bg-card inset-ring inset-ring-border flex flex-col gap-4 p-4"
          }
          data-testid="item"
        >
          <MediaFrame alt={d.name} ratio="1/1" />
          <Stack gap="4" class={(((layout as string) === "rows") ? "md:col-span-2" : "")}>
            <Stack gap="2">
              <Text size="lg" weight="semibold">
                {d.name}
              </Text>
              <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
                {d.summary}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
            <OptionChips name={tpl("{0}-size-{1}", id, d.id)} legend={labels.size} options={sizes} />
            <OptionChips name={tpl("{0}-crust-{1}", id, d.id)} legend={labels.crust} options={crusts} />
            <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="mt-auto">
              <Inline class="text-xl font-bold">
                {fmtMoney(d.price, d.currency)}
              </Inline>
              <Button variant="default" size="default" type="button" aria-label={tpl(labels.addOf, d.name)} data-testid="add">
                {labels.add}
              </Button>
            </Group>
          </Stack>
        </Box>
      {/each}
    </Box>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
